limits: Detection is lexicon-based and English-first. A clean result means no listed term was matched — it is not evidence that the corpus is unbiased, and a non-English corpus will under-report on every dimension.
Representation counts surface terms, not people. A corpus discussing a group without using its listed vocabulary is invisible to this measure.

With 52 embedded chunks per snapshot, two identical corpora would score a mean PSI of about 0.346 from sampling alone. The bands were raised to 0.692 / 1.039 accordingly — a real shift smaller than that cannot be distinguished from noise at this sample size.
limits_tr: Tespit sözlük tabanlıdır ve önce İngilizcedir. Temiz bir sonuç, listelenen hiçbir terimin eşleşmediği anlamına gelir — külliyatın önyargısız olduğunun kanıtı değildir ve İngilizce olmayan bir külliyat her boyutta eksik raporlanır.
Temsil, insanları değil yüzey terimlerini sayar. Listelenen kelime dağarcığını kullanmadan bir gruptan söz eden bir külliyat bu ölçüm için görünmezdir.

Anlık görüntü başına 52 gömülü parça ile, iki özdeş külliyat yalnızca örnekleme nedeniyle yaklaşık 0.346 ortalama PSI alırdı. Bantlar buna göre 0.692 / 1.039 seviyesine yükseltildi — bundan küçük gerçek bir kayma, bu örneklem büyüklüğünde gürültüden ayırt edilemez.

limits: Detection is lexicon-based and English-first. A clean result means no listed term was matched — it is not evidence that the corpus is unbiased, and a non-English corpus will under-report on every dimension.
Representation counts surface terms, not people. A corpus discussing a group without using its listed vocabulary is invisible to this measure.

With 52 embedded chunks per snapshot, two identical corpora would score a mean PSI of about 0.346 from sampling alone. The bands were raised to 0.692 / 1.039 accordingly — a real shift smaller than that cannot be distinguished from noise at this sample size.

remediation.title: De-duplicate the corpus by content hash
remediation.rationale: 62 redundant copies occupy retrieval slots that would otherwise hold distinct evidence, and inflate every recall figure measured on this collection.
steps: Group chunks by a whitespace- and case-normalised SHA-256 of their text.
Keep the copy with the richest metadata; delete the rest.
Add the same hash as a uniqueness constraint at ingestion so it cannot recur.
Re-run `atheros-kit rag audit` to confirm the group count is zero.
remediation.risk: Deleting the wrong copy loses its metadata. Keep the richest, not the oldest.
remediation.code:
from atheros_kit.rag import assess_chunks
report = assess_chunks(connector.chunks())
for fingerprint, ids in report.exact_duplicates.items():
    keep, remove = ids[0], ids[1:]      # inspect metadata before choosing
    print('delete', remove)             # then delete via YOUR store's client

remediation.title: Embed the chunks that have no vector
remediation.rationale: 1 chunks are in the corpus and absent from the index. They can never be retrieved, and every recall number computed over this collection is optimistic by that amount.
steps: Collect the orphan ids from the quality report.
Re-run the embedding step for exactly those ids — not the whole corpus.
Confirm the new vectors match the collection's existing dimension.
Make the ingestion fail loudly when an embedding call returns nothing.
remediation.risk: Embedding with a different model than the rest of the collection is worse than leaving them absent — it corrupts distances for every query.

remediation.title: Redact personal data at ingestion
remediation.rationale: 1 chunks carry structurally recognisable personal data (EMAIL). Under Art. 10 and GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) a knowledge base should hold what the task needs and no more.
steps: Run `atheros_kit.guard.Anonymizer` over documents in the ingestion pipeline.
Re-ingest the affected documents from source, masked.
Delete the unmasked chunks; masking a copy does not remove the original.
Add the masking step to CI so new documents cannot bypass it.
remediation.risk: These detectors are structural. Names and free-text identifiers are NOT caught, so this count is a floor. Do not treat a clean re-run as proof of a clean corpus.
remediation.code:
from atheros_kit.guard import Anonymizer
anon = Anonymizer(reversible=False)   # ingestion never needs to restore
clean = anon.mask(document_text).text

remediation.title: Rebalance corpus representation for 'gender'
remediation.rationale: The 'gender' dimension fails the four-fifths rule (ratio 0.1731). A retrieval layer returns what the corpus contains, so this imbalance reaches every answer.
steps: Identify source documents covering the under-represented groups: feminine, masculine, non_binary.
Augment with real documents first. Synthetic augmentation is a last resort and must be labelled as synthetic in metadata.
Re-run the bias scan and compare the ratio, not the score.
If augmentation is impossible, down-sample the dominant group and record the decision — a smaller balanced corpus is defensible; a large skewed one is not.
remediation.risk: Never re-weight retrieval to mask this. It hides the imbalance from the metric while leaving it in the evidence base, which is the failure mode Art. 10 exists to prevent.

remediation.title: Review how 'gender' groups are described
remediation.rationale: Groups are present in comparable numbers but described in measurably different language (gap 2.0). This is the form of bias that survives a representation audit and reaches the model intact.
steps: Pull the chunks mentioning the negatively framed groups and read them.
Distinguish accurate domain language from editorialising in the source.
Where the source is the problem, replace the document; where the extraction is, fix the pipeline.
Re-run and compare the sentiment spread per group.
remediation.risk: This one needs human reading. An automated rewrite of source documents destroys the provenance that makes them evidence.

remediation.title: Extend the 'age' lexicon or confirm absence
remediation.rationale: 'age' could not be scored. That is an open question, not a pass — the corpus either does not discuss it or discusses it in vocabulary the lexicon does not carry.
steps: Read a sample of chunks and decide which of the two is true.
If the vocabulary is wrong, pass `extra_dimensions=` with your domain terms.
If the dimension genuinely does not apply, record that decision so the gap is not re-litigated every quarter.
remediation.risk: None. But leaving it unresolved means the Fairness Score describes less of the corpus than a reader will assume.
